_help: Lakilester's PM64 sprite rows on c_pokopi, Bombette's method: the body is the model's (his head plane, shell, hair spike and hands; the paper cloud), posed on every sprite frame (step keys at the sprite's own frames, 0.5 units a sprite pixel, root = the sprite's bob); the features are the sprite's own pixels for that frame, read from the player's ROM at runtime: face = his goggles and mouth (no skin) over the head's own (follows pPlane2; the head texture's drawn mouth painted out); cloud_face = the cloud's eyes and mouth (follows pPlane9; its own eye and mouth planes hidden); arm1..arm3 = his arms where the sprite draws them (follow root), joining the model's hands. Burnt rows: the body recoloured to PM64's burnt greys. Our numbers only.

F0.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 0 Still (loops every 1 frames); the still frame (port: frozen poses)

F1.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 1 Idle (loops every 144 frames); field idle (port pm64_partner_pc.c kAnims A_IDLE)

F2.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 2 StrainIdle (loops every 144 frames); riding Mario, standing (PM64 world ride; port pm64_field_pc.c ride)

F3.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 3 IdleTough (loops every 144 frames); PM64 world cutscenes (tough pose)

F4.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 4 Tired (loops every 1008 frames); field hurt (port kAnims A_HURT)

F5.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 5 Walk (loops every 72 frames); field walk (port kAnims A_WALK)

F6.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 6 StrainWalk (loops every 72 frames); carrying Mario on the cloud, moving (port kAnims A_MOVE; pm64_field_pc.c ride)

F7.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 7 Run (loops every 144 frames); field run, jump and fall (port kAnims A_RUN/A_JUMP/A_FALL)

F8.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 8 StrainRun (loops every 144 frames); carrying Mario, running (PM64 world ride)

F9.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 9 Talk (loops every 144 frames); field talk (port kAnims A_TALK)

F10.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 10 TiredTalk (loops every 144 frames); PM64 world cutscenes (tired talk)

F11.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 11 Shout (loops every 36 frames); PM64 world cutscenes (shout)

F12.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 12 Vanish (plays 16 frames, then holds); PM64 world: vanishing into a puff

F13.pm64: WorldLakilester anim 13 Celebrate (loops every 36 frames); field glad (port kAnims A_GLAD)
